name: Accidental Necromancy
source:
What will you do when you accidentally bring your best friend back from the dead?

You play as Lark (default name- can be changed), a potion maker that runs an Apothecary in a small town. After a visit to the grave of your late best friend, Ollie, you’re shocked when he knocks on your door later that night!

Spend time with Ollie while you try to figure out how you brought him back. Meet someone new. Discover family secrets.

[From [url=https://eerie-mori.itch.io/accidental-necromancy-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你一不小心把挚友从死神手中复活了回来，你该怎么办？

你将扮演拉克（默认姓名，可自由更改），一名在小镇上经营着药铺的魔药师。某天，你去祭拜已故挚友奥利的墓碑，谁知当天深夜，他竟活生生地敲响了你的家门！

一边与奥利共度时光，一边查明自己究竟是如何将他复活的；邂逅新的面孔，揭开尘封的家族秘密。

[摘自[url=https://eerie-mori.itch.io/accidental-necromancy-demo]itch.io[/url]]
